title: Dispatch checks lose their region setting
root_cause: The workflow stopped supplying ARDEN_DISPATCH_REGION to the test step. The dispatch configuration requires a nonempty region at startup, so the test process exits before running its assertions. The earlier successful run has no available job log, limiting verification of its environment.

relevant_evidence.why: The Node test process fails while loading the required region setting.
The configuration requires a nonempty environment variable.
